description: This file defines a validator class for LocationTag objects within the OpenMRS project. It implements validation logic to verify that LocationTag instances have required fields filled and that certain string fields meet length constraints.

classes.name: LocationTagValidator
classes.description: A validator class for LocationTag objects that enforces required fields and length constraints.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports LocationTag class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the target object, checking for non-empty 'name' and validating field lengths for 'name', 'description', and 'retireReason'.
